decisions.reason: The webhook setup procedure does not change any public Mission-page copy or presentation requirement.
Configuring contract-event ingestion does not change the required wallet-warning outcome or its developer-verification remediation method.
The infrastructure procedure does not direct any change to the About-page content, including its existing description of Base.
The source configures a backend webhook and does not require any FAQ copy to be added, removed, or revised.
The webhook name, network, address, and URL do not affect the landing-page hero's copy, layout, or visual treatment.
Using ProjectRebuild in the webhook name reflects the existing brand and does not rename the current or planned product.
Selecting Base Mainnet for the contract-event webhook is consistent with the existing Base deployment requirement and does not change its blockchain or network-class state.
The contract webhook configuration does not alter Mauritius access restrictions for the landing page.
The source provides an event-ingestion setup procedure and neither changes nor reports the production site's availability behavior.
The backend webhook configuration does not modify any landing-page mechanics wording or emphasis.
Collecting all contract logs does not itself change winner announcement channels, notification channels, conditions, or guidance.
Using a contract address for webhook ingestion does not change the established migration strategy, superseded-contract policy, or data-continuity policy.
